subject: general
question: An electric motor is a device used for converting electrical energy into _________ energy.
solution:
The correct answer is **Mechanical.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mechanical energy
 
 
• The energy of a **moving item **or the energy that an object stores due to its location.
 
• Mechanical energy is the total kinetic and potential energy.
 
• In order to efficiently create electricity or convert energy, many sources of renewable energy depend on mechanical energy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Light
 
 
• Electromagnetic radiation that can be seen by the human eye is known as light, or visible light.
 
• Photons are bundles of the electromagnetic field that contain a set amount of energy and are the building blocks of light.
 
• Kinetic energy includes light energy.
 
 
 
• Heat
 
 
• Heat is produced when kinetic energy moves within a material or an object, or when kinetic energy moves from an energy source to a material or an object.
 
• Such energy may be transported through three different mechanisms: radiation, conduction, and convection.
 
• An object's heat is made up of all of the energy of all** internal molecular motion**.
 
 
 
• Magnetic
 
 
• The ability to cause** attracted and repelling** events in other things is referred to as magnetism, which is a category of physical characteristics that are mediated by a magnetic field.
 
• Magnetism is created by** moving electric charges**.
